mapper.select: SELECT a.appointment_id,a.appointment_no,a.status,a.cancel_reason,a.updated_at,cu.display_name customer_name,eu.display_name engineer_name FROM appointment a JOIN system_user cu ON cu.user_id=a.customer_id JOIN system_user eu ON eu.user_id=a.engineer_id WHERE a.status IN ('PENDING_RESCHEDULE','EXPIRED') ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC
SELECT l.*,u.display_name FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=l.user_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT 80

SELECT '预约总数' metric,COUNT(*) metric_value FROM appointment UNION ALL SELECT '完成工单',COUNT(*) FROM repair_order WHERE order_status='COMPLETED' UNION ALL SELECT '配件申请',COUNT(*) FROM part_request UNION ALL SELECT '有效评价',COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE status='VALID'
SELECT a.appointment_id,ro.order_id,a.customer_id FROM appointment a JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.appointment_id=a.appointment_id WHERE a.status='PENDING_RESCHEDULE' AND a.updated_at<#{threshold}
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_order SET order_status='CANCELLED' WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment_change(appointment_id,change_type,old_status,new_status,operator_id,reason) VALUES(#{appointmentId},'RESCHEDULE_TIMEOUT','PENDING_RESCHEDULE','EXPIRED',#{adminId},'待改约超过系统配置时限')
mapper.select: SELECT a.appointment_id,a.customer_id,a.engineer_id,es.service_date,st.start_time FROM appointment a JOIN engineer_schedule es ON es.schedule_id=a.schedule_id JOIN standard_time_slot st ON st.slot_id=es.slot_id WHERE a.status='BOOKED' AND es.service_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND #{untilDate}
SELECT order_id,engineer_id FROM repair_order WHERE order_status IN ('REPAIRING','WAITING_PARTS','REWORK') AND created_at<#{threshold}
SELECT user_id FROM system_user WHERE role_type='WAREHOUSE' AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT part_request_id FROM part_request WHERE status='PENDING' AND created_at<#{threshold}

SELECT notification_id FROM notification WHERE receiver_id=#{receiverId} AND notification_type=#{notificationType} AND related_business_type=#{businessType} AND related_business_id=#{businessId} LIMIT 1
